memory_model.load: per-byte allocated/readable check, ordered Except binds and actual little-endian assembly
memory_model.store: per-byte allocated/writable check and update in lane/byte order; failure retains preceding write state
memory_model.all_pid_loads: loadWords result is matched before pid-zero gate; nonzero programs can fail
memory_model.output_tail: No allocation/readability/writability constraints on output tail; its latent bytes and allocated-content view remain unchanged.

memory_model.unloaded_placeholders: loadWords/loadedPrefix use zero outside the loaded prefix only as a mathematical container placeholder, never an active-store value or a claim about original no-other masked-load values.
memory_model.scheduling: arbitrary complete permutation of whole programs; no interleaving within/between their instructions

structural_remaining.gap: Native allocation, storage and access permissions
structural_remaining.detail: The custom partial interface is a total mathematical byte payload plus explicit allocated/readable/writable maps. Native device allocation, memory validity, access rights, little-endian layout, alignment and provenance are not related to those maps. Full-N input readability and first-tile output writability are selected-domain premises, not host-established facts.

Every active input byte of every pid now passes a failing-access bind before the store gate. The nonzero-pid missing-byte theorem distinguishes this from the old total memory-effect projection. This custom interpreter still has no stepwise Python/TTIR/compiler bridge. Deterministic first-unavailable-byte errors and retained partial-write states are mathematical semantics, not native traps, poison, sanitizers or observable fault order. Scalar comparisons/conversions are pure total callbacks; nonzero-pid scalar results are not separately evaluated and no native instruction trace follows. Unloaded entries in loadWords/loadedPrefix are zero placeholders used only to complete the mathematical container; original no-other masked-load values are not specified.

Logical name distinction, numeric interval separation, B1024, N<2^31 and representable endpoints remain theorem premises. Native empty_like freshness, layouts/strides, shifted/overlapping aliases, other sizes/blocks, launch limits and native zero-grid/error behavior remain open. No allocation or permission is required for the unmodified output tail.

structural_remaining.gap: Native instruction interleaving and remaining dtype/module scope
structural_remaining.detail: All complete permutations of whole programs are proved in the partial-access model. Programs remain atomic relative to each other; native instruction interleavings and races remain open. The same nine finite-word profiles are refined with no new dtype names. Prior fp64/fp8/error families and host/harness/module/compiler target scope remain required.
